failures.why: the harness no longer marks a release as made without an intent record (rp-harness 063cb6d5), so the fact turn.last.without.intent stays 0 for new turns until RPE counts it itself from the order in which the record and the reply's first text arrived

leftovers.name: rpe-standin-*
leftovers.why: the stand-in's database removes its folder only in close() (test/standin/db.ts:169, :201-203), so a rig that fails before closing it leaves the folder

leftovers.name: rpe-door-*
leftovers.why: openDoor's close removes its folder first and the app's cleanup after, so the folder outlives the run (test/adapter/door.ts:72-77; PlanAdapter-S17 item 3)

leftovers.name: lre-runtime-*
leftovers.why: the bed of the runtime's copy of LumiAH removes a runtime's folder only when that runtime closes or the process exits (test/support/runtime-bed.ts:57-61), and the harness tests of the copy leave them; the copy of LumiAH goes with PlanSwap-8 and PlanSwap-10
